_readme: The 6 MCX commodity underlyings tracked for F&O via the GapFill checkpoint. Verbatim data moved from curatedUnderlyings.json's 'commodities' array -- nothing reshaped, nothing recomputed. Edit this file directly to add/remove/adjust a commodity; curatedUnderlyingsLoader.js reads it as-is.

commodities.notes: Fut+opt symbols confirmed via live Fyers screenshot (MCX:CRUDEOILM26AUGFUT, MCX:CRUDEOILM26AUG7900CE). Gap + ATM reference confirmed by commodities desk. No Saturday session, single cycle -- confirmed.

OPTIONS-ONLY TRACKING TARGET -- Silver Micro (SILVERMIC, the contract actually traded for capital efficiency) has NO listed options; SILVERM's options are used instead, confirmed by commodities desk. ATM reference confirmed via the same screenshot (SILVERMQ2026 marker sitting on the futures price line between strikes).

ATM reference confirmed via the same screenshot (GOLDMQ2026 marker on the futures price line).

FUTURES-ONLY. No options exist for this contract -- confirmed by commodities desk and MCX's own product list (Options page lists Silver Mini, not Silver Micro). Not part of the ATM merge-check at all; only needs the separate current+next-month futures roll (not yet built).
